amount.description: What the receipt settles of it, in the invoice's currency: at most what is open of it (RECEIPT-05).

in_full.description: Settle the invoice in full: what is left of it after the amount clears to 7030 in this receipt's month as a settlement difference, when it is within the organisation's settlement tolerances (FR-BNK-08: S$1.00, or for another currency the greater of S$1.00 and 3% of the invoice, at most S$50.00 an invoice and S$200.00 a month by default); a larger difference is refused (RECEIPT-11) and is a write-off.

invoice_id.description: The invoice: one of the customer's issued invoices, in the receipt's currency.
